dedupe_keys.name: climate impact explorer climate analytics and iiasa

description: The Climate Impact Explorer gives projections of physical climate risk for continents, countries and their provinces at different levels of global warming and over time for policy-relevant emissions scenarios, including those of the Network for Greening the Financial System (NGFS), the Climate Action Tracker current policies path and, since the 2025 update, a high-warming variant based on the 20% of simulations with the strongest warming. Indicators cover climate, heat, drought, extreme precipitation, fire weather, freshwater, labour productivity and agriculture to 2100, with uncertainty ranges and model agreement, aggregated by area, GDP or population. It builds on CMIP and ISIMIP impact simulations with downscaling and bias correction, and holds socio-economic conditions at 2020 levels to isolate the effect of climate change. It is developed by Climate Analytics and IIASA with funding from the ClimateWorks Foundation, Bloomberg Philanthropies and the German research ministry; all maps, graphs and underlying data can be downloaded free from the web interface, with a required citation. Caveats: it is a screening tool that does not replace detailed national risk assessments, resolution is coarse, and ISIMIP inputs carry their own terms. It supports hazard and scenario inputs for national infrastructure risk screening and climate stress tests; a related record is the NGFS climate scenarios.
licence: Free use with attribution (citation required); ISIMIP source terms apply
